brief_title: Therapeutic Strategies for Type 2 Diabetes Based on Lifestyle Changes: Plant-based Diet and Physical Exercise
official_title: Therapeutic Strategies for Type 2 Diabetes Based on Lifestyle Changes: Plant-based Diet and Physical Exercise
collaborators: Conselho Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico

arm_groups.label: Strict Vegetarian Diet, Regular Physical Exercise, and Placebo Administration
Strict Vegetarian Diet, Regular Physical Exercise, and Probiotic Supplementation

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in Waist, Abdominal, and Hip Circumference
Change in Functional Aerobic Capacity (1-Mile Walk Test)
Change in Functional Mobility (Up and Go Test)

brief_summary: The study evaluates the impact of a strict vegetarian diet combined with regular physical exercise and the use of probiotics on metabolic, inflammatory, and epigenetic parameters in patients with type 2 diabetes. It aims to determine the influence of these interventions on gut microbiota, glycemic control, body composition, insulin resistance, and quality of life.
